name: TpllKit
description: Raises the artificial character limits on text inputs (trigger/text-object popups) while you are in the level editor.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn the raised text limit on or off.

unlimited.name: Unlimited
unlimited.description: Remove the cap entirely (up to 2,147,483,647 characters, the most the game can store). Overrides 'Character limit'. Very long text can freeze the editor.

char-limit.name: Character limit
char-limit.description: New maximum length for free-text inputs. Very large values can make the editor slow when rendering text.

number-fields.name: Include number boxes
number-fields.description: Also raise the limit on number-only boxes (IDs, values). Very large numbers can overflow and behave strangely. Password boxes are never changed.

show-notice.name: Show proof notice
show-notice.description: Show a small notice the first time TpllKit raises a limit in a session.

editor-only.name: Editor only
editor-only.description: Only raise limits while the level editor is open. Leaves account, comment and level-upload fields untouched.
